title: rhus × ashei
intro: Rhus × ashei, commonly known as the Texas sumac, is a hybrid plant species within the Anacardiaceae family, resulting from the cross between Rhus glabra (Smooth Sumac) and Rhus lanceolata (Lance-leafed Sumac). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Rhus × ashei are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
